properties.site-address: Government Buildings and Harcourt House, Marston Road, Oxford, OX3 0TY
properties.notes: The site is allocated for housing, student accommodation and/or education in the Sites and Housing Plan adopted in February 2013. The site is also allocated in the emerging Local Plan 2036, which is currently undergoing an examination in public (consultation on proposed modifications following hearings). Key worker housing linked to the hospital is identified as a suitable use. General housing and student accommodation are identified as acceptable complementary uses. Hospital operations would need to be maintained.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
